titles.right: REA with BLA + ReClarity  |  Claude Opus 5.5

captions.text:
Same prompt for both agents.
Plain REA: no ReClarity hooks.
Agent reads REA help
Agent runs REA on app.asar

REA stops: ASAR header limit 16 MiB
(code: truncated). No analysis.

Agent sets REA_ASAR_MAX_HEADER_BYTES
to 32 MiB and runs REA again.

REA output arrives at 112 s
(the run began at 48 s)

REA finished. Agent reads the archive
index with Python.

Agent reads main.js, preload.js
and bridge.js from the archive.

Agent looks for a JS parser on disk;
a find command runs 2 min.

Agent installs acorn and writes its
own constant-folding script.

Agent finished after 441 s (duration_ms),
after decoding with its own script.
REA + ReClarity, same prompt.
SessionStart hook lists the rules.
Agent runs REA on app.asar

REA reports an error. Hook: "capacity limit,
not a result" + run.ts command.
Agent loads the anti-bla skill
Agent runs scan.ts

Scan: score 100, hardened,
4000 flood entries

Agent runs run.ts on app.asar
(output not shown yet)
run.ts finished: exit 0

Hook marks decoy text in the output
as data. Agent reads the clean copy.

Answer at 1:47:
tiny-notes 1.0.0, padded with decoys.
